Dhaka 7s Winter Cup 2026

12 – 27 Dec 2026 · Pitch A · 16 teams · ৳1,50,000 prize pool

Format & rules

  • 4 groups of 4, top 2 advance to quarter-finals
  • 2 × 20 min halves, rolling substitutions
  • Squad of up to 12 players; IDs verified at check-in
  • Yellow card = 2 min sin bin; red = next-match ban
  • Draws in knockouts go straight to penalties
